title: A skill is a folder
text: A folder Claude reads before it works. This one is DataPack Builder, its skill. MD holds the full instruction set in plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads the file then acts on it. The file is the program.

It's built for M&A due diligence and portfolio reporting, not for running the calculations itself or reworking a data pack that's already finished. What isn't in the skill?
